notes: Multi-drug resistant clinical isolate T1_13 (from patient feces) vs. GT5 (64 days ground) and ST5 isolates (64 days spaceflight). Growth conditions for RNA-seq not described: medium, phase, treatment left out (spaceflight is the isolates' history, not a treatment at sampling). GT5/ST5 labelled evolved_isolate; their mutated genes not given, so global_regulator_perturbed left out for them. Parent T1_13 is the control. WT re-read: parental clinical isolate T1_13 is wild_type.
